actions: Re-verified current public Argus main and inspected canonical event writer/rotation, planner-verdict persistence scan, Supervisor retry path, legacy stable-handle snapshot precedent, and Windows msvcrt daemon-lock precedent.
Refined candidate010 from generic reader omission to a direct durable-write consequence: an unstable/incomplete planner-verdict persistence scan can return False and authorize another verdict emit.
Specified FOUND/ABSENT/UNKNOWN persistence evidence and a shared stable-generation snapshot primitive with platform-specific POSIX/Windows behavior.
Persisted a role-local checkpoint and advanced role-local LATEST with a nonempty frontier.

findings.planner_verdict_scan: planner_verdict_was_persisted enumerates events.jsonl* pathnames then opens them later, swallows OSError, and returns bool; Supervisor re-emits when that bool is false.
findings.fail_closed_contract: Only a complete stable snapshot may prove ABSENT. Snapshot/open/read uncertainty is UNKNOWN and must keep the outbox pending without another canonical emit.
findings.argus_positive_control: legacy Manager-handoff recovery already opens event-generation handles under shared events.lock and scans pinned handles after lock release.
findings.windows_lock_reuse: event_log.py has POSIX fcntl only, while daemon_lock.py already implements msvcrt byte-range exclusive locking on Windows.

connector_mutation_incident.side_effect: branch created pointing at then-current main; no files or commits added on that branch
connector_mutation_incident.remediation_attempt: Searched the available GitHub connector surface for branch deletion; no delete-ref/delete-branch action was exposed, so no further mutation was attempted.
connector_mutation_incident.next_control_requirement: Before the next substantive invocation, effective control must satisfy the root revision-12 requirement that an incident-bearing role carry an equivalent explicit role-local read-only discovery/write-boundary guard.

termination.blocker: No branch-delete capability was exposed for remediating the accidental branch; substantive research itself is not globally complete.
termination.exact_next_action: Re-bootstrap under the then-current control. If the incident-bearing-role local guard is present, add source-shaped planner-verdict FOUND/ABSENT/UNKNOWN regressions, consolidate the cross-platform stable-generation snapshot/lock helper, map the Windows independent-sink rollover regression, then feed the same snapshot primitive into Mission View reconciliation.
